title: Towards Unified Multimodal Graph Foundation Model: A Bridge-Router-Adapter Based Approach
abstract: arXiv:2609.06668v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal graphs couple node attributes in different modalities, such as text and images, with relational structure, enabling topological structure and cross-modality attributes to be modeled jointly. Multimodal graph foundation models seek unified representations from such data that transfer across different graph domains and downstream tasks. However, existing methods exhibit two fundamental limitations. (1) Cross-Scope Context Entanglement. They merge scope-specific graph contexts into a unified representation, obscuring their distinctions during multimodal construction. (2) Scope-Ignorant Modality Routing. They route modalities within a fixed graph scope, overlooking how modality relevance varies across neighborhood ranges. To address these challenges, we propose BRAIN, a unified model that focuses on graph context that combines neighborhood scope with modality composition. translated_title: 迈向统一的多模态图基础模型：一种基于桥接-路由-适配器的方法
translated_abstract: 多模态图将不同模态（如文本和图像）的节点属性与关系结构相结合，使拓扑结构和跨模态属性能够被联合建模。多模态图基础模型旨在从这类数据中学习可跨不同图领域和下游任务迁移的统一表示。然而，现有方法存在两个根本性局限：（1）跨范围上下文纠缠，它们将特定范围的图上下文合并为统一表示，在多模态构建过程中掩盖了它们之间的差异；（2）范围无关的模态路由，它们在固定的图范围内进行模态路由，忽视了模态相关性如何随邻域范围而变化。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了BRAIN，一个专注于结合邻域范围与模态构成的图上下文的统一模型。BRAIN包含一个以范围为条件的桥接器，它结合了……
tldr: 提出BRAIN——一个基于桥接-路由-适配器架构的统一多模态图基础模型，通过将邻域范围与模态构成相结合的范围条件化图上下文建模，解决了现有方法中跨范围上下文纠缠和范围无关模态路由两大局限。
en_tdlr: BRAIN is a unified multimodal graph foundation model based on a Bridge-Router-Adapter architecture that addresses cross-scope context entanglement and scope-ignorant modality routing by modeling graph context conditioned on both neighborhood scope and modality composition.
